skills.name: Mathematics
skills.description: While at UTAS I studied maths into third year maths courses, primarily obtaining HDs. This involved topics such as Fourier and Laplace transforms, topology, diff/integral calculus, and other applied engineering mathematics including what was required for circuit analysis, signals and linear systems, kinematics (dynamics, statics).

skills.name: Circuit theory and analysis
skills.description: While at UTAS, I studied and achieved high grades in circuit theory. This involved mathematically analysing AC and DC circuits and electrical systems.

skills.name: Control systems
skills.description: At UTAS, I studied control and process control systems and all associated mathematics. This involved a lot of maths and gaining a thorough understanding of all of the theory and practice behind control systems such as PIDs.

skills.name: Computer and data networks.
skills.description: I studied data networks at UTAS. This involved topics such as designing and implementing complex data networks and IoT systems.

skills.name: Digital electronics
skills.description: At UTAS I studied digital electronics. During this time I was required to design and build circuits such as adders and processors using boolean logic gates as well as more abstracted components such as diodes, transistors, flip-flops and registers.
